series_end_reason: Day One was acquired by Servier and deregistered; its last periodic report is the FY2025 10-K. 8-K filed 2026-04-23 (accession 0001193125-26-171997): 'on April 23, 2026, the Servier Parties completed the acquisition of the Company ... with the Company continuing as the surviving corporation ... and a wholly owned subsidiary of Parent'; a Form 15-12G followed on 2026-05-04. Servier does not file with the SEC, so 2026Q1 onward is not printed on sec.gov.
search_log: Listed every filing for CIK 1845337 (Day One Biopharmaceuticals) via data.sec.gov/submissions; fetched every 10-Q/10-K and every exhibit of each 8-K with item 2.02 filed 2024-01 to 2026-11 and searched for 'OJEMDA'. No filing prints an 'OJEMDA' table row; the product is reported as the 'Product revenue, net' line (sole commercial product).

Q2/Q3 read from the 10-Q statements of operations (three-month column); Q4 derived as the full-year 'Product revenue, net' in the Q4 earnings release (8-K Ex. 99.1) less the nine-month column of the Q3 10-Q, because no filing prints a fourth-quarter three-month table.

Checks: 2024Q4 derived 28,955 thousand vs release text 'fourth quarter ... $29.0 million'; 2025Q4 derived 52,834 thousand vs release text '$52.8 million'. 2025 quarters 30,503 + 33,562 + 38,522 + 52,834 = 155,421 = printed full year. Prior-year columns of 2025Q2/Q3 10-Qs (8,192; 20,070) equal the 2024 rows.
No filing after the FY2025 10-K (filed 2026-02-24) reports a quarter: the company was acquired on 2026-04-23.
